events.verdict: Walker (IND) reaches for the ball and marginal contact occurs with Christie's (DAL) arm as he makes his intended pass at the end of the drive.
Jackson (IND) reaches in and brushes Powell's (DAL) arm as he enters his shooting motion.
Flagg (DAL) directly contests Walker's (IND) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Walker's (IND) hand after the release.
Dennis (IND) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Washington (DAL) is already in Jackson's (IND) path when contact occurs, and he absorbs the contact during the pick.
Siakam (IND) initiates contact with Christie's (DAL) arm and the contact affects his ability to control the ball.
Christie's (DAL) left hand makes contact with Siakam's (IND) arm, which affects his jump shot attempt.
Jackson (IND) initiates body to body contact with Williams (DAL) that affects his SQBR as he brings the ball up the court.
Marshall (DAL) legally contests Siakam's (IND) jump shot attempt.
